sn_access=apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]['password'])['access_token']
# But we already logged in above; re-login safely.
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=sn_access, note_id=1608)
content=note['content']
# Extract movie titles and directors from the content lines
import re
movies=[]
current=None
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    if line.startswith('- director:') or line.startswith('- director：'): # not expected
        pass
    # Title lines are those without leading '-' and not header
    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9\'\-\s]+$', line) and not line.startswith('#') and not line.lower().startswith('director') and not line.lower().startswith('genre'):
        current=line
        # ensure it seems like a title
        if current and current not in ['# Movie Recommendations']:
            movies.append({'title':current,'director':None})
    elif line.startswith('- director:'):
        if movies and movies[-1]['director'] is None:
            movies[-1]['director']=line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
# Filter for David Fincher directed movies
fincher=[m['title'] for m in movies if m['director']=='David Fincher']
print('fincher', fincher)
# If parsing missed, fallback by regex for '- director: David Fincher' near preceding title
if not fincher:
    # regex capture title preceding bullet
    pattern=re.compile(r'(?:\n|^)([A-Za-z0-9\'\-\s]+)\n\s*- director:\s*David Fincher\n', re.M)
    fincher=pattern.findall(content)
    print('fallback fincher', fincher)
# Create comma-separated list
reply=', '.join(fincher)
print('reply', reply)

# Send SMS to Christopher Burch (phone 4275730168)
phone_access=apis.phone.login(username='3155673041', password=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password'])['access_token']
resp=apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number='4275730168', message=reply, access_token=phone_access)
print('send_resp', resp)
